objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Locally defined or business process-related regulations and instructions

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Specific procedures and process sequences with details and responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed work steps and test instructions for sub-processes

objs.name: document
objs.description: General document object managed in the system with properties and versioning

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of document (Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction)

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document identifier composed of abbreviation, number, and title

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the document

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Non-controlled document attachment not subject to release cycle

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document that is released with the main document

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed amendment to an existing document

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Request to extend validity period of a document approaching expiration

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person interacting with the document management system

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: User role in the system (Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator)

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with common authorization and distribution rights

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of users and user groups to receive document notifications

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature applied by workflow participant

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: Record of all changes and actions performed on a document

objs.name: pdf_version
objs.description: Automatically converted PDF rendering of a document

objs.name: translation
objs.description: Language-specific version of a released document

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of new document object with selection of document type and template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using integrated editing client

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Modification of document metadata and attributes

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of reader, author, reviewer, and releaser permissions

evts.name: create_workflow_task
evts.description: Initiation of document release workflow by author or co-author

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Application of electronic signature by workflow participant

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Technical and formal checking of document content by reviewer

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approval and publication of document by releaser

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication making document visible to assigned readers

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of new document version when released version is revised

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachment for archiving when new version is released

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of proposed amendment to document without affecting current version

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Incorporation of change proposal into new document version

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Finalization of change proposal after document editing

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System-generated request when document approaches validity expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approval to extend document validity period by 3 years

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of request to invalidate document with no additional validity

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Formal invalidation and archiving of document and attachments

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of request to reactivate invalidated document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validation of archived document with new version creation

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Automatic email notification to distribution list on document release

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported request for active confirmation of document receipt

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by recipient of document acknowledgement

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document into another language

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of document to PDF format
